title: Wilted Quick Japanese Chives Kyushu Udon
description: A sour and aromatic Japanese dish featuring chives, perfect for a quick Kyushu-inspired meal.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium soy sauce for a more delicate flavor

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: To balance the acidity of the dish

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Minced fresh ginger for added depth

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for a more nuanced flavor

instructions: Cook the Udon noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chives and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to wilt.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar, and stir to combine.
Return the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Garnish with thinly sliced green onions and serve immediately.
